Students and Apprentices

Frequently Asked Questions

I live in a shared flat. Who pays?

Only one fee is due per dwelling. The flatmates can decide who pays.

back to 'Frequently Asked Questions'

I live in a student hall of residence. Do I have to pay?

Yes, if your room is lockable and accessible from a hallway.
